workshop.title: The Workshop
workshop.summary: Lumen turns a folder of notes into a page you can hand someone. [[composer]] writes, [[library]] keeps the stack, [[scanner]] refuses secrets, and [[publisher]] puts the file on the press. [[theme]] paints mocha or latte. [[site]] is the only thing that leaves the room.
workshop.howBuilt: One HTML template plus a JSON model. The agent surveys a repo, fills the model, injects it, and runs a secret scan before anything is published. [[identity]] is optional: if a here.now key is already on the machine, the press uses it. No key means a 24h anonymous page.
workshop.howToRead: Tall blocks measure or refuse. Short blocks store or emit.

nodes.label: Composer
nodes.summary: Reads the repo map and writes the diagram model: groups, blocks, edges, and staged packets.
nodes.howBuilt: An agent workflow, not a compiler. It prefers README and architecture docs, then entrypoints. It will not make a block per file.

nodes.label: Library
nodes.summary: The working JSON model. Input to the injector, not a deliverable.
nodes.howBuilt: A single object with views keyed by id. See references/model.md in the skill.

nodes.label: Scanner
nodes.summary: The measuring tower. Walks the model and the HTML for secret-shaped values and refuses to let them leave.
nodes.howBuilt: scripts/scan.py. Prefixes, PEM blocks, and high-entropy assignments to secret-looking names. A hit is a stop, not a warning.

nodes.label: Identity
nodes.summary: Optional here.now credentials already on the machine. Never written into the page.
nodes.howBuilt: Reads $HERENOW_API_KEY or ~/.herenow/credentials. If neither exists, publish stays anonymous. The value never enters the model.

nodes.label: Publisher
nodes.summary: Injects the model into the template and either writes a file or sends the folder to here.now.
nodes.howBuilt: scripts/inject.py validates the model, then publish.sh uploads a directory whose root is index.html.

nodes.label: Theme
nodes.summary: Catppuccin Mocha when the browser prefers dark, Latte when it prefers light. A toggle can override.
nodes.howBuilt: CSS variables on :root and [data-theme]. No webfonts, no CDN.

nodes.label: Site
nodes.summary: The only artifact that leaves: a self-contained page or a here.now URL.
nodes.howBuilt: One HTML file. No network calls at runtime. The public URL is the only thing reported after publish.

scanner.title: Scanner
scanner.summary: Two checks, then a verdict. [[patterns]] catch known secret prefixes. [[assignments]] catch a secret-looking name bound to a long random value. [[verdict]] is the only output.
scanner.howBuilt: A short Python walk over the model strings, then the same prefixes over the raw HTML. Placeholders such as redacted or <token> are allowed.
scanner.howToRead: The tower is a pipeline. Dots moving down are candidate strings. A red packet means the file must be rewritten.

nodes.label: Prefix rules
nodes.summary: Regular expressions for tokens, PEM blocks, and cloud key ids.
nodes.howBuilt: PREFIX_PATTERNS in scripts/scan.py. Add a pattern when a new vendor prefix shows up. Do not add English words.

nodes.label: Assignments
nodes.summary: Finds password, token, or api_key bound to a long mixed-alphabet string.
nodes.howBuilt: ASSIGNMENT plus an entropy heuristic. Obvious placeholders pass.

nodes.label: Verdict
nodes.summary: Exit 0 and the word clean, or exit 1 and a list of paths. No middle.
nodes.howBuilt: The skill treats a failed scan as a hard stop. Redact the model and run the scan again.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.summary: [[inject]] writes the model into the template. [[upload]] talks to here.now when that is the destination. [[finalize]] is the moment the URL exists.
publisher.howBuilt: inject.py is local and dependency-free. Upload and finalize are the here.now publish script. The page is not live until finalize returns.
publisher.howToRead: Left to right is the file path. The last block is the only one the reader of the diagram should hear about.

nodes.label: Inject
nodes.summary: Validates required fields, parent and inside links, and unique codes, then splices the JSON into the template.
nodes.howBuilt: scripts/inject.py. Fails closed on a missing view or a dangling edge.

nodes.label: Upload
nodes.summary: Creates or updates a site and sends the HTML. Uses saved credentials when present.
nodes.howBuilt: here.now publish.sh --client cursor. Never pass --api-key in chat.

nodes.label: Finalize
nodes.summary: The site is live. The only number that matters is the public URL.
nodes.howBuilt: Report siteUrl. Mention permanent vs 24h from publish_result.auth_mode. Stop unless asked to do more.
